description: This PHP source file defines the class EmployeeCsvImportSampleAttachmentController, which is responsible for serving a sample CSV file for employee data import in the OrangeHRM application. The handle method initializes the response with CSV headers and sample content that includes employee data fields.

classes.name: EmployeeCsvImportSampleAttachmentController
classes.description: Controller handling the delivery of a CSV sample file for employee data import, extending from AbstractFileController.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Prepares and returns an HTTP response containing a CSV sample string with employee data headers.
